name: Adult Lumbar Spondylolisthesis
definition: Anterior translation of one vertebra relative to the one below; adult forms commonly include degenerative and isthmic spondylolisthesis.

typical: Leg pain or numbness may occur
Standing/walking intolerance may reflect associated stenosis
Flexion or sitting may relieve stenotic leg symptoms

redFlags.item: Progressive weakness, frequent falls or cauda equina features

investigations.principle: Assess slip, instability and neural compression according to symptoms.
investigations.radiographs: Standing radiographs can demonstrate slip; dynamic views may be used selectively for instability.
investigations.MRI: Useful for associated neural compression/stenosis and concordant radicular symptoms.

green: Track walking tolerance and neurological status
amber: Persistent disabling symptoms, neurological deterioration or clinically important instability may require spine-surgical assessment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Possible Gridhrasi/Katishoola symptom correlations remain descriptive only and do not replace the structural diagnosis.

patientEducation.summary: Anterior translation of one vertebra relative to the one below; adult forms commonly include degenerative and isthmic spondylolisthesis.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for new/progressive major weakness, gait deterioration, bladder/bowel dysfunction, saddle sensory loss, fever/systemic illness with severe spinal pain, or cancer-associated neurological symptoms.

sources.title: Adult Spondylolisthesis of the Low Back
